theme_atlas <- function(base_size = 12) {
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 2),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "#555555", size = base_size),
      axis.text          = element_text(colour = "black"),
      legend.position    = "right",
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0", colour = NA),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#eeeeee"),
      plot.caption       = element_text(colour = "#444444", size = 9, hjust = 0)
    )
}
    
theme_set(theme_atlas())

# ── Helper: dollar formatting ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt_dollars <- function(x, accuracy = 0.1) {
  scales::label_dollar(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M", accuracy = accuracy)(x)
}

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
#### Load Data ####
# File paths 
data_dir <- here("data", "processed")
meta_dir <- here("data", "metadata")

awards_files <- list(
  HuBMAP = file.path(data_dir, "NIHReporter-HuBMAP-awards-clean.csv"),
  HTAN   = file.path(data_dir, "NIHReporter-HTAN-awards-clean.csv"),
  SenNet = file.path(data_dir, "NIHReporter-SenNet-awards-clean.csv")
)

# NIH Code Look-up files
ic_lookup_file  <- file.path(meta_dir, "NIH_institute_codes_lookup.csv")
activity_lookup_file <- file.path(meta_dir, "NIH_activity_codes_lookup.csv")

# Consortia RFA to Division Code Cross-walk
division_crosswalk_file <- file.path(meta_dir, "NIH-map_consortia-rfa-metadata.csv")

# Load & bind awards
awards_raw <- 
  purrr::imap_dfr(awards_files, function(path, consortium) {
  data.table::fread(here::here(path), encoding = "UTF-8",
                    colClasses = c(duns_number="character")) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename("consortium" = "project_id")
})

# NIH Grant Activity Codes
activity_lookup <- 
  read.csv(file=activity_lookup_file, header=TRUE)
# NIH Institute Codes
ic_lookup <- 
  read.csv(file=ic_lookup_file, header=TRUE)

# Load RFA / opportunity-number → division look-up 
# Note: the source file contains a typo ("opportunity_number"); we rename on load
# so the rest of the pipeline uses the correct spelling throughout.
division_lookup <- 
  read.csv(file=division_crosswalk_file, header = TRUE) %>%
  select(opportunity_number, division, division_type, division_name)

rm(activity_lookup_file, ic_lookup_file, division_crosswalk_file, awards_files)
```

```{r prep-data, include=FALSE}
#### Standardize column names (snake_case) ####
# NIH Reporter exports use title-case column names with spaces; rename to
# snake_case equivalents that match the data dictionary.
awards <- 
  awards_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ str_to_lower(str_replace_all(.x, "[ /()]", "_")) %>%
                str_replace_all("_{2,}", "_") %>%
                str_remove("_$")) %>%
  rename(
    org_name = organization_name,
    org_city = organization_city,
    org_state = organization_state,
    org_type = organization_type,
    org_zip = organization_zip,
    org_country = organization_country,
    admin_ic = administering_ic
  )

# Generate Core_Project_Number if not already present
if (!"core_project_number" %in% names(awards)) {
  awards <- awards %>%
    mutate(
      core_project_number = paste0(activity, administering_ic, serial_number)
    )
}

# Parse date columns
awards <- 
  awards %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(project_start_date, project_end_date,
             budget_start_date,  budget_end_date),
           ~ lubridate::mdy(.x)),
    type = as.character(type)
  )

# Classify parent vs sub-project records
awards <-
  awards %>%
  mutate(
    is_subproject = !is.na(subproject_number) & subproject_number != "") %>%
  mutate(
    # Use the appropriate cost column
    total_cost_used = if_else(is_subproject==TRUE,
                        total_cost_sub_projects,
                        total_cost)
  )

# Award type labels
type_labels <- c(
  "1" = "New",
  "2" = "Competing Renewal",
  "3" = "Supplement",
  "4" = "Competing Extension",
  "5" = "Non-Competing Continuation",
  "7" = "Change of Institution",
  "9" = "Change of IC"
)

awards <- 
  awards %>%
  mutate(type_label = recode(type, !!!type_labels, .default = "Other"))


# Division join QC objects (consumed in Section 2)
division_summary <- 
  awards %>%
  group_by(consortium) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Awards     = n(),
    Matched_Division = sum(!is.na(division)),
    Unmatched        = sum(is.na(division)),
    Pct_Matched      = round(Matched_Division / Total_Awards * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

unmatched_opps <- 
  awards %>%
  filter(is.na(division)) %>%
  distinct(consortium, opportunity_number, type_label) %>%
  arrange(consortium, opportunity_number)
```

# Overview

This document presents an analysis of the award and funding landscape for three NIH-funded
biomedical mapping programs:

- **[Human BioMolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP)](https://hubmapconsortium.org/)** — mapping the human body at single-cell resolution
- **[Human Tumor Atlas Network (HTAN)](https://humantumoratlas.org/)** — building a 3-D atlas of cancer transitions
- **[Cellular Senescence Network (SenNet)](https://sennetconsortium.org/)** — characterizing the role of cellular senescence in human health

The analysis addresses four objectives:

1. **Project & award inventory** — Quantify the core projects, award IDs, and sub-awards associated with each initiative.
2. **Funding summary** — Calculate total, direct, and indirect funding overall and cross-tabulated by consortium division.
3. **Temporal funding cycles** — Characterize how project funding evolved across fiscal years.
4. **Funding flow** — Visualize the flow of resources from funding opportunity → NIH institute/center → core project → award → PI/organization → cost type → division.

<div class="note-box">
**Data source:** NIH Reporter awards data retrieved via the NIH Research Portfolio Online
Reporting Tools (RePORTER) API. Records were cleaned and consortium division metadata were
integrated during earlier pipeline steps (script 10). Division assignments are derived
by joining each award's `opportunity_number` using `NIH-map_consortia-rfa-metadata.csv`. See
the pipeline summary document for full provenance details.
</div>

## Division assignment quality check {-}

Before any analysis, we verify that the RFA look-up successfully assigned a division to each
award record. Non-competing continuations and administrative supplements often share the
same opportunity number as their parent award and should match; PA-series numbers are not
included in the look-up and will appear as unmatched.

```{r division-qc, echo=FALSE}
division_summary %>%
  kbl(
    col.names = c("Consortium", "Total Awards", "Matched", "Unmatched", "% Matched"),
    caption   = "**Table 1.** Division assignment match rate by consortium.",
    align     = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(5, bold = TRUE,
              color = if_else(division_summary$Pct_Matched == 100,
                              "#008042", "#f0a500"))
```

```{r division-qc-unmatched,echo=FALSE}
if (nrow(unmatched_opps) > 0) {
  unmatched_opps %>%
    DT::datatable(
      caption  = htmltools::tags$caption(
        style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left;",
        htmltools::strong("Table 0b."),
        " Award records with no division match — distinct opportunity numbers."
      ),
      colnames = c("Consortium", "Opportunity Number", "Award Type"),
      options  = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
      rownames = FALSE
    )
} else {
  cat('<div class="note-box">✓ All award records matched to a division.</div>')
}
```
# NIH Mapping Program Award Record Descriptive Analysis {#inventory}

## Overall Awards, Projects and Funding Summary {#funding}

```{r inventory-counts, echo=FALSE}
# Count distinct entities per consortium 
inventory <- 
  awards %>%
  select(consortium, application_id, core_project_number, project_number, 
         is_subproject, fiscal_year, total_cost_ic) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(consortium) %>%
  summarise(
    core_projects = n_distinct(core_project_number),
    total_awards = n_distinct(application_id),
    parent_awards = n_distinct(project_number),
    sub_awards = n_distinct(project_number[is_subproject]),
    first_year = min(fiscal_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(fiscal_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_cost_M   = round(sum(total_cost_ic, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

inventory %>%
  kbl(
    col.names = c("Mapping Program", "Core Projects", "Award Records", "Parent Awards",
                  "Sub-Awards", "First Year", "Last Year",
                  "Total Cost (M)"),
    caption   = "**Table 2.** Overview of NIH mapping program award records.") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE,
              color = consortium_colours[inventory$consortium])
```

```{r bargraph-consortia_inventory, fig.cap="**Figure 1.** Mapping programs awards are compared using bar graphs; A compares the count of total award records for programs. B compares core projects of each program; C compares total costs of each program across all parent awards.", fig.height=6, echo=FALSE}
# Total award records granted to consortia (parent+sub_awards across multiple years)
inv_total <- 
  inventory %>%
  select(consortium, total_awards) %>%
  pivot_longer(-consortium, names_to = "type", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type,
    total_awards = "Total Awards",
  ),
  type = factor(type, labels = c("Total Awards (non-unique)")))

# Unique set of award identifiers - core projects, parent awards and sub projects 
inv_long <- 
  inventory %>%
  select(consortium, core_projects, parent_awards, sub_awards) %>%
  pivot_longer(-consortium, names_to = "type", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type,
    core_projects  = "Core Project",
    parent_awards  = "Parent Award",
    sub_awards     = "Sub Award"
  ),
  type = factor(type, labels = c("Core Project", "Parent Award", "Sub Award")))

p1 <- 
  ggplot(inv_total, aes(x = consortium, y = count, fill = consortium)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = consortium_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    tag = "A",
    x = NULL, y = "Count",
    fill = "Mapping Program") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical")

p2 <- 
  inv_long %>%
  filter(type=="Core Project") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = consortium, y = count, fill = consortium)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = consortium_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    tag = "B",
    x = NULL, y = "Count",
    fill = "Mapping Program",
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical")

funding_real <-
  awards %>%
  filter(is_subproject==F) %>%
  group_by(consortium) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cost   = sum(total_cost_ic, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(consortium, Total_Cost) %>%
  pivot_longer(-consortium, names_to = "Cost_Type", values_to = "Amount") %>%
  mutate(Cost_Type = recode(Cost_Type,
    Total_Cost   = "Final Total Cost"
  ),
  Cost_Type = factor(Cost_Type, levels = c("Final Total Cost")))

limits = c(0,225000000)

# Real funding - total costs - Inset A
p3 <- 
  ggplot(funding_real,
         aes(x = fct_reorder(consortium, Amount, sum, .desc = TRUE),
             y = Amount, fill = consortium)) +
    geom_col(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = consortium_colours) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = ~ scales::dollar(.x, scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),
                       limits=limits) +
    labs(
      tag = "C",
      x = NULL, y = "USD (millions)",
      fill = "Mapping Program",
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.direction = "vertical")

# plot design
design <-
"12
 3#"

# Plot
fig1 <- 
  p1+p2+p3 +
  plot_layout(design = design,
              guides="collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical")
fig1
```

## Program Parent Award Types and Activity Codes

```{r award-types, echo=FALSE}
type_counts <- 
  awards %>%
  filter(!is_subproject) %>%                          # parent records only
  select(consortium, type_label, project_number) %>% 
  distinct() %>%                                      # distinct project ids-cuts record of awards funded by multiple IC
  count(consortium, type_label, name = "awards") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = consortium, values_from = awards, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))))) %>%
  rename("Award Type" = "type_label") %>%
  adorn_totals(name="Total Awards")

type_counts %>%
  kbl(
    caption = "**Table 3.** Parent award counts by application type and consortium.",
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(type_counts), bold = TRUE)
```

```{r activity-codes, echo=FALSE}
activity_counts <- 
  awards %>%
  filter(!is_subproject) %>%
  distinct(consortium, project_number, activity) %>%
  count(consortium, activity, name = "n") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = consortium, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))))) %>%
  left_join(activity_lookup %>% 
              select(activity_code, title), 
            by=c("activity"="activity_code")) %>%
  select(activity,title,HTAN,HuBMAP,SenNet) %>%
  arrange(activity) %>%
  rename("Activity Code" = "activity",
         "Activity Title" = "title") %>%
  adorn_totals(name="Total Awards")

activity_counts %>%
  kbl(caption   = "**Table 4.** NIH mapping program parent award activities.",
      format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(activity_counts), bold = TRUE)
```

```{r alluvial-consortia-award_type+activity_code, fig.cap="**Figure 2.** A bimodal network visualizing the relationships between NIH funding award types and activities codes for biomedical mapping consortia, HTAN, HuBMAP, and SenNet.", fig.width=8, fig.height=7, echo=FALSE}
consortia_type_activity <-
  awards %>%
  filter(is_subproject==FALSE) %>%
  select(consortium, project_number, 
         type, type_label, activity) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(activity_lookup %>%
              select(activity_code,title) %>%
              rename("activity_label" = "title"), 
            by=c("activity"="activity_code")) %>%
  group_by(type_label, activity_label, consortium) %>%
  summarise(weight = n_distinct(project_number),
             .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename("award_type" = "type_label",
         "activity_type" = "activity_label") %>%
  mutate(award_type = factor(award_type, 
                             levels=c("New","Supplement",
                                      "Competing Extension",
                                      "Competing Renewal",
                                      "Non-Competing Continuation")),
         activity_type = factor(activity_type,
                                levels=c("Phase I  Exploratory/Developmental Cooperative Agreement",
                                         "Phase II Exploratory/Developmental Cooperative Agreement",
                                         "Research Project--Cooperative Agreements",
                                         "Research Project--Other Transaction Award",
                                         "Specialized Center--Cooperative Agreements",
                                         "Resource-Related Research Multi-Component Projects and Centers Cooperative Agreements",
                                         "Resource-Related Research Projects--Cooperative Agreements"),
                                labels=c("Phase I  Exploratory/Developmental\n
                                          Cooperative Agreement",
                                         "Phase II Exploratory/Developmental\n
                                          Cooperative Agreement",
                                         "Research Project--\nCooperative Agreements",
                                         "Research Project--\nOther Transaction Award",
                                         "Specialized Center--\nCooperative Agreements",
                                         "Resource-Related Research Multi-Component\n
                                          Projects and Centers Cooperative Agreements",
                                         "Resource-Related Research Projects--\n
                                          Cooperative Agreements")),
         consortium = factor(consortium, 
                             levels=c("HTAN","HuBMAP","SenNet")))

# Fig 2. Bi-modal network via alluvial diagram
ggplot(consortia_type_activity,
         aes(y = weight, 
             axis1 = award_type, axis2 = activity_type)) +
    geom_alluvium(aes(fill=as.factor(consortium)), 
                  width=1/10, discern=TRUE) +
    geom_stratum(width=1/10, 
                 discern = TRUE) +
    geom_text(stat = "stratum", 
              discern = TRUE, 
              size = 8,
              size.unit = "pt",
              position = "nudge",
              aes(label = after_stat(str_wrap(stratum,width=45)))) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Award Type", "Activity Code"),
                     expand=expansion(mult=.28)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,400,50),
                       guide=guide_axis(cap="both")) +
    scale_fill_discrete(palette=consortium_colours, limits=
                          c("HuBMAP","HTAN","SenNet")) +
    labs(fill = "Mapping Program",
         y="Funded Projects") +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Research Division Funding

```{r funding-by-division1, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Division is now guaranteed by the RFA look-up join in prep-awards.
# Unmatched records (NA division) are kept as "Unassigned" so no cost is lost.
funding_div <- 
  awards %>%
  filter(is_subproject==F) %>%
  select(consortium, division_type, division, project_number, total_cost_ic) %>%
  mutate(division = factor(division,
                           levels=c("DCC", "HIVE", "CODCC", "DEMO", 
                                    "HTA", "PCA", "TMC_S", "TMC_H","TDA", "RIT","TTD"),
                           labels=c("Data Coordinating Center (DCC)",
                                    "HuBMAP Integration, Visualization and Integration (HIVE) Collaboratory",
                                    "Consortium Organization and Data Coordination Center (CODCC)",
                                    "Demonstration Projects (DEMO)",
                                    "Human Tumor Atlas Research Centers (HTA)",
                                    "Pre-Cancer Atlas Research Center (PCA)",
                                    "Tissue Mapping Center (TMC)",
                                    "Tissue Mapping Center (TMC)",
                                    "Technology Development and Application (TDA)",
                                    "Rapid Technology Integration (RTI)",
                                    "Transformative Technology Development (TTD)")),
         division_type = factor(division_type, 
                                levels=c("data_administration","tissue_mapping_center",
                                         "technology_development"),
                                labels=c("Data Administration",
                                         "Tissue Mapping Center",
                                         "Technology Development"))) %>%
  group_by(consortium, division_type, division) %>%
  summarise(
    projects = n_distinct(project_number),
    cost = sum(total_cost_ic, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cost = round(sum(total_cost_ic, na.rm = TRUE) / n_distinct(project_number),0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(funding_real %>% select(consortium, Amount),
            by="consortium") %>%
  mutate(percent_total_cost = round(cost/Amount*100,1)) %>%
  select(-Amount) %>%
  arrange(consortium, division_type, division)

funding_div %>%
  rename("Mapping Program"="consortium") %>%
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", .x, fixed = TRUE))) %>%
  kbl(caption  = "**Table 5.** An overview of NIH mapping program research division total and mean project costs.",
      format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) 

```

```{r bargraph-division_funding, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="**Figure 3.** Total funding for NIH Mapping consortia, split organizational divisions; color is assigned to consortia; division labels are shown on the y-axis."}
p4 <- 
  funding_div %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = division, y = cost, fill = consortium)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = consortium_colours, na.value = "grey70") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = ~ scales::dollar(.x, scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
                       breaks=seq(0,125000000,25000000)) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ consortium, scales = "free_y", space="free_y", ncol = 1) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Cost (USD, millions)") +    
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
p7 <- 
  funding_div %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = division, y = mean_cost, fill = consortium)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = consortium_colours, na.value = "grey70") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = ~ scales::dollar(.x, scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ consortium, scales = "free_y", space="free_y", ncol = 1) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean Project Cost (USD, millions)") +    
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank())

fig3 <- 
  p4 + p7

fig3
```

## Temporal Funding Cycles {#temporal}

```{r annual-funding, include=FALSE}
## Annual funding analysis
annual_funding <-
  awards %>%
  filter(is_subproject==F) %>%
  group_by(consortium, fiscal_year) %>%
  summarise(
    projects      = n_distinct(project_number),
    total_cost    = sum(total_cost, na.rm = TRUE),
    # direct_cost   = sum(direct_cost_ic, na.rm = TRUE),
    # indirect_cost = sum(indirect_cost_ic, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  # mutate(cost_gap = total_cost-(direct_cost + indirect_cost)) %>%
  arrange(consortium, fiscal_year)

```

```{r linegraph-consortia-annual-funding, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="**Figure 4.** Line graphs compare annual NIH mapping program awarded projects and total funding, based on fiscal year of award records; A compares the total number of projects awarded to each program; while B compares annual funding for awarded to each program.", fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
# Annual projects funded
p5 <- 
 ggplot(annual_funding, aes(x = fiscal_year, y = projects,
                   colour = consortium, group = consortium)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = consortium_colours) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ~ seq(floor(min(.x)), ceiling(max(.x)), 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.10))) +
  labs(
    tag = "A",
    x = "Fiscal Year",
    y = "Number of Full Projects",
    colour = "Mapping Program",
  ) 

# Annual Funding
p6 <- 
  ggplot(annual_funding, 
       aes(x = fiscal_year, y = total_cost,
           color = consortium, group = consortium)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = consortium_colours) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = ~ seq(floor(min(.x)), ceiling(max(.x)), 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = ~ scales::dollar(.x, scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      tag = "B",
      x = "Fiscal Year",
      y = "Total Cost (USD, million)",
      colour = "Mapping Program",
    )

# Plot coalesce
fig4 <-
  p5 + p6 +
  plot_layout(#design = design,
              guides="collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig4
```
